messages:
jon: FYI nightly eval flagged a quality drop after the fp8 profile 'calib-surge-fp8' was used for rwd-7b-v2 on the summarization suite. rouge1 down ~2.1%.

eval-bot: nightly-eval | model=rwd-7b-v2 profile=calib-surge-fp8 dataset=summarization metrics={rouge1: 0.433 -> 0.424 (-2.16%), rougeL: 0.420 -> 0.411 (-2.14%)}

sara: thanks. artifact URL?

jon: uploaded artifacts: https://storage.redwood.ai/ci/1755001234/calib-surge-fp8/eval_artifacts.tar.gz

kai: looked into recent quant changesPR 938 reduced clip_multiplier from 2.0 -> 1.1 in quant/collector. that would shrink observed activation ranges and can produce tiny scales for fp8.

maria: grabbed the calibration dump. layer_21 shows scale=7.2e-05 with min=-0.00015 max=0.00014  that's too small for fp8 dynamic range.

jon: i can reproduce locally. command:
```
./tools/run_eval --model rwd-7b-v2 --profile calib-surge-fp8 --dataset summarization --seed 13 --save-calib out/calib.json
```

sara: paste the layer snippet?

jon: snippet:
```
"layer_21": {"min": -0.00015, "max": 0.00014, "scale": 7.2e-05, "zero_point": 0}
```

kai: confirmed. when scale < ~1e-4 fp8 quant noise dominates. the clip multiplier drop in PR 938 matches this symptom.

maria: note: runtime v1.10.0 landed yesterday and swapped to a fused fp8 rounding kernel; that kernel is more sensitive when scales are tiny so combined effect is worse.

dev-bot: Action scheduled: rollback profile calib-surge-fp8 -> previous-profile at 2025-11-09T03:30Z if hotfix not applied

sara: i'd rather do a targeted hotfix: enforce a min_scale floor in the calibration reducer (suggested min_scale=2.5e-4) and emit a per-layer warning so CI fails loudly.

jon: quick local patch with min_scale=2.5e-4 ran fine: rouge1 recovered to 0.431 (delta -0.46% vs baseline). much closer to baseline.

kai: i'll open a hotfix PR that adds the min_scale, a unit test that simulates near-zero ranges, and a changelog entry. PR will reference this thread.

maria: also propose adding a CI guard: fail any calibration run with per-layer scale < 5e-5 and attach artifacts. prevents silent regressions.

sara: agreed. i'll change nightly-eval config to include that threshold and wire an alert to #eng-ml when triggered.

jon: assigning: @kai -> hotfix PR, @sara -> nightly config + alert, @maria -> hold rollback and monitor. i'll rerun a full summarization suite after PR lands.

kai: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/quant/pull/942  adds min_scale=2.5e-4, test/quant/test_min_scale.py, and a CI annotation.

eval-bot: rerun-complete | model=rwd-7b-v2 profile=calib-surge-fp8-hotfix dataset=summarization metrics={rouge1: 0.432 -> baseline 0.433 (delta -0.23%), rougeL: 0.419 -> baseline 0.420 (delta -0.24%)}

maria: hotfix looks acceptable; i'm going to hold rollback. will watch the next two nightlies closely and check per-layer warnings.

jon: follow-ups: merge PR after one approver (maria or jon), add CI guard (sara), add an eval-e2e regression test to the harness (kai). close when two nightlies show no degradation.

sara: noted. i'll post next nightly result here.

kai: tagging reviewers now, ETA ~25m for approvals.

eval-bot: nightly-eval (next) | model=rwd-7b-v2 profile=calib-surge-fp8-hotfix dataset=summarization metrics={rouge1: 0.433 -> baseline 0.433 (delta 0.0%)}  marking stable for now."
